question_en:
I am the digital coordinator for a small museum and need to arrange photography equipment for all collection objects in the image. Please answer:

Based on the medium and dimensions in the official records, which photography equipment should each object be assigned to? Use the "Large-Format Flatbed" for two-dimensional works with a longest side of at least 150 cm; use the "Large-Object Stand" for items with a clear third dimension and a longest side of at least 150 cm; use the "Object Turntable" for other items with a clear third dimension; and use the "Standard Flatbed" for all other objects. Please provide a complete list covering all objects in the image, with each line stating the object number, object name, and photography category, and separately tally the counts for the four photography categories.

The answer must include a table of "Object Number—Object Name—Photography Category" and a count of the four photography categories after the table.
